freeze.creator: Navneet Prabhakar
freeze.initialization: New canonical random chain required: IDs differ from iteration one. No reused embeddings or optimizer state.
freeze.limitations: Train-only fitting, with validation and test token-sizing metrics reported separately. Exact-message token counts do not establish substring or semantic uniqueness. This is a pilot-specific freeze; broader language/styles/content/tools and production selection remain open.
freeze.selection: Select 16K for the laptop experiment: 24K saves 3.53 percent of serialized validation positions but adds 4194304 parameters and a 50 percent larger vocabulary dimension. No measured latency or memory-speed tradeoff is claimed. Heldout token counts and development byte round-trips are sizing evidence, not language-quality selection.

scope: All admitted train rows prepared once, without truncation. Preparation ceiling is not a training allowance. Optimizer comparison, cumulative physical budget, main schedule and validation protocol still must be frozen before launch.

token_preparation.scope: Verified bootstrap release to disk-backed token shards; tokenizer selection and model training are separate gates
